name: microbench-for-one-mechanism
note: a mechanism claim about coalescing is tested by one existing microbenchmark, not a campaign

input.conjecture: The device memory burst is wide enough that a two-element-unrolled contiguous read should not beat a single narrow read on this operator.
input.expected_observation: sectors_per_request stays within 5% of its current value as load width doubles

conjecture.expected_observation: sectors_per_request stays within 5% of its current value as load width doubles
conjecture.statement: The device memory burst is wide enough that a two-element-unrolled contiguous read should not beat a single narrow read on this operator.

notes: an unverified conjecture may inspire hypotheses and cannot be grounds for verification
keep it in kb/conjectures/ until the plan has run; promotion is a replay-gated move

cases: the narrowest shape range the conjecture claims
experiments.why_minimal: one microbenchmark isolates the mechanism without a campaign; it may already be answerable from the ledger, so check the ids first

outcome_table.open: the experiment could not be made valid: not_implemented, correctness failed, or the counters were absent
outcome_table.promoted: the observation appears and the metric moves as predicted: sectors_per_request stays within 5% of its current value as load width doubles
outcome_table.refuted: the experiment is valid and the observation does not appear

plan.promotion_path: promotion makes it a candidate rule with this experiment as its single confirmation; it still cannot be used as evidence to verify anything until a second operator confirms it
